LanguageData.Grechka_LuckyBlockT1_Item.label: lucky block T1
LanguageData.Grechka_LuckyBlockT1_Item.description:
Place the block on the map and right-click it to order a pawn to open it. The result will appear nearby. Blocks do not stack.
